use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

struct P(x: double, y: double) is
    -(o: P) -> P => P(x - o.x, y - o.y)
    ×(o: P) -> double => x * o.y - y * o.x

    length: double => Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y)
    to_string() -> string => "({x}, {y})"
si

distance(p: P, from: P, to: P) -> double =>
    let line = to - from in
    if line.length == 0.0D then (p - from).length
    else Math.abs(line × (p - from)) / line.length
    fi

simplify(points: List[P], epsilon: double) -> List[P] is
    let last = points.count - 1
    let far mut = 0
    let farthest mut = 0.0D

    for i in 1..last do
        let d = distance(points[i], points[0], points[last])

        if d > farthest then
            far = i
            farthest = d
        fi
    od

    if farthest <= epsilon then
        return [points[0], points[last]]
    fi

    let left = simplify(points[0::far], epsilon)
    let right = simplify(points[far::last], epsilon)

    return left |> take(left.count - 1) |> cat(right) |> collect_list()
si

let line = [
    P(0.0D, 0.0D), P(1.0D, 0.1D), P(2.0D, -0.1D), P(3.0D, 5.0D),
    P(4.0D, 6.0D), P(5.0D, 7.0D), P(6.0D, 8.1D), P(7.0D, 9.0D),
    P(8.0D, 9.0D), P(9.0D, 9.0D)
]

let simple = simplify(line, 1.0D)

write_line(simple |> join(" "))

let image = IMAGE(400, 400)

image.view(-0.5D, -0.5D, 9.5D, 9.5D)
image.clear(252ub, 252ub, 250ub)

draw(points: List[P], width: double, size: double) is
    image.stroke(width)
    image.line(points |> map(p => (x = p.x, y = p.y)) |> collect_list())

    for p in points do
        image.dot(p.x, p.y, size)
    od
si

image.colour(170ub, 170ub, 180ub)
draw(line, 6.0D, 7.0D)

image.colour(200ub, 50ub, 40ub)
draw(simple, 2.0D, 4.0D)

image.write("simplified.png")

image.show("simplified.png")
